newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil May trade deficit seen at $100 mln - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil May trade deficit seen at $100 mln - paper.

text.p: The Brazilian government hopes the trade deficit will shrink to $100 million in May after hovering around the $1-billion level for seven months, a newspaper said.
The government is optimistic given the increase in agricultural exports, especially of soybeans, but also coffee, chicken and pork, O Globo said.
The trade balance should also benefit from a decrease in oil imports on the back of increased domestic production, O Globo said.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
